At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with procurement teams:

Procurement
  Delegated: Prepare quotation requests, compare supplier responses and track the approved order.
  Stays with you: Supplier selection, spending commitments and exceptions require the buyer’s authority.
  Exception: Two offers meet a requirement at different prices.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.

See the procurement workflow: https://uieglobal.com/solutions/procurement/?utm_source=outreach&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pilot-2026-11&utm_content=t1-procurement
